`custom-test-font.ttf` is Source Serif 4 Regular (static TTF, `glyf`
outlines), used only as a *test fixture* for
`subset::tests::works_on_a_non_default_font` — a regression check that
subsetting isn't accidentally tied to Source Sans 3's specific table
layout. Not embedded in the shipped crate/binary. Licensed under the SIL
Open Font License 1.1, see `custom-test-font-LICENSE.md`.
